name: equity_screen_fake
study: FAKE: an invented receipt for league/tests/test_equity_screen.py only; not a measurement, never pinned
rule: FAKE (the S1 rule's shape only). Step 0 (floor): c_p and c_H on the program's own null worlds; c_used = max(c_R, c_p). Step 1 (pre-check): (RT >= 20 or ID >= 120) and sum r > 1e-12. Step 2 (after the one look): pooled t >= c_used, holdout sum r > 1e-12 and t_H >= c_H. Label S1-X: the same steps on x with c_X, no floor: alpha or beta.

look.rule: pooled t over V+H daily r >= c_used and sum_H(r) > 1e-12 and t_H >= c_H; sd < 1e-12 fails

floor.c_p: smallest c on 0.00..5.00 (step 0.01) with share(t* >= c) <= fp_cap at BOTH L = 194 and L = 251
floor.c_H: smallest c on the same grid with share(t_H >= c and sum_H > 0) <= fp_cap, at both L
floor.worlds: IND22 and IND1622, 20,000 worlds each, V = 250 and H = L
floor.null: N0: r0 = r - w * kappa, kappa = sum_pool(r) / sum_pool(w)
floor.seed: numpy default_rng([20261010, 1010, set_id, L, 0]); set_id 3 = IND22, 5 = IND1622
floor.ineligible: no pool of >= 300 sessions, or c_p > 5.00 or c_H > 5.00

windows.holdout: the holdout, capped; calibrated for 194..251 sessions

lineage.retry: only after the first try FAILED its pre-check (no look spent), the retry version hashed at the first try (R3)
lineage.same_lineage: Train daily returns correlating >= 0.7 with a program already looked at, or the same template
lineage.no_feedback: look and Validation outcomes never reach generators or the diagnostician

stated_beside_every_live_trade: S1-R, c_used = {c_used}, c_H = {c_H}, this program's FP at zero edge = {own_fp}% (cap 12%; owner's wall 15%), drift-kept pass rate = {n1}% (not a false positive: the goal counts direction); S1-X: {alpha|beta} (FP {fpx}%); contamination: FAKE fixture sentence
